title: Science Paper Fixes a Name Mistake
title_zh: 科学论文改了一个名字错误

image.credit: Photo by Benja Godin on Unsplash
image.author: Benja Godin

lead: A science journal fixed a small mistake in a paper. One writer's name was wrong. Now it is correct.
lead_zh: 一家科学期刊修改了论文里的一个小错误。有一位作者的名字写错了。现在改对了。

preview_zh: 一个科学团队写了一篇关于细胞的论文。论文在 2026 年 9 月 30 日发表。期刊《自然》刊登了它。很多科学家一起完成了这篇论文。
paragraphs: A science team wrote a paper about cells. The paper came out on 30 September 2026. The journal Nature published it. Many scientists worked on this paper together.
Later, the team found a problem. One writer's last name was wrong. The name was Navarrette, but it should be Navarrete. The journal says sorry for this small mistake.
On 8 October 2026, the journal shared a correction. The new name is now in the online paper and in the PDF. The science in the paper does not change.
The paper is about how our body makes antibodies. Antibodies help us fight sickness. The writers work in Canada and Chile. Their study helps us understand our blood cells better.
paragraphs_zh: 一个科学团队写了一篇关于细胞的论文。论文在 2026 年 9 月 30 日发表。期刊《自然》刊登了它。很多科学家一起完成了这篇论文。
后来，团队发现了一个问题。一位作者的姓写错了。名字写成了 Navarrette，但应该是 Navarrete。期刊为这个小错误道歉。
2026 年 10 月 8 日，期刊发布了更正。新名字现在出现在网络版论文和 PDF 里。论文里的科学内容没有改变。
这篇论文讲的是我们的身体如何制造抗体。抗体帮助我们抵抗疾病。作者们在加拿大和智利工作。他们的研究帮助我们更好地了解自己的血细胞。
body:
A science team wrote a paper about cells. The paper came out on 30 September 2026. The journal Nature published it. Many scientists worked on this paper together.

Later, the team found a problem. One writer's last name was wrong. The name was Navarrette, but it should be Navarrete. The journal says sorry for this small mistake.

On 8 October 2026, the journal shared a correction. The new name is now in the online paper and in the PDF. The science in the paper does not change.

The paper is about how our body makes antibodies. Antibodies help us fight sickness. The writers work in Canada and Chile. Their study helps us understand our blood cells better.

2026 年 10 月 8 日，期刊发布了更正。新名字现在出现在网络版论文和 PDF 里。论文里的科学内容没有改变。

text: A science team wrote a paper about cells. The paper came out on 30 September 2026. The journal Nature published it. Many scientists worked on this paper together. Later, the team found a problem. One writer's last name was wrong. The name was Navarrette, but it should be Navarrete. The journal says sorry for this small mistake. On 8 October 2026, the journal shared a correction. The new name is now in the online paper and in the PDF. The science in the paper does not change. The paper is about how our body makes antibodies. Antibodies help us fight sickness. The writers work in Canada and Chile. Their study helps us understand our blood cells better.
